RecapFlowAI edits media on your device. Optional AI Clips sends your selected source video to Google Gemini after your consent using your own API key. Use media you have permission to edit and share, and check provider eligibility and billing. Review AI suggestions before applying them. Voiceover, TTS and Narrator integration are deferred. Public-store policy review remains pending.

Local editing stays on your device. Optional Gemini analysis uploads the source video to Google, including audio and visible text. Free-service inputs may be used for product improvement. The app encrypts and saves your API key on this device, excluded from backups. It requests deletion of its uploaded file after analysis or cancellation; network failures may delay deletion until provider expiry. Account sign-in and advertising are not included. Public-release privacy policy publication remains pending.

This build is a development preview. Use the app lawfully, keep backups of original media, and review exports before publishing. Features and behavior may change during development. Public-release terms will be finalized before store distribution.

RecapFlowAI uses open-source components including AndroidX, Material Components, Media3, and FFmpeg-related native components. Each component remains subject to its own license terms. Complete third-party notices must be reviewed and finalized before public store release.
